surfaces.part: top cap / lid of the sign (white ellipse with green mark)
main sign panel with the 약국 text (vertical front face)

answer.evidence: Width profile 0:8, 1:12, 2-6:16, 7:12, then 8-30:14. The cap widens, stays at 16, and narrows again before the 14-wide body. It is wider than the shaft and has a dark rim at row 7 and a dark row at row 8. This reads as an ellipse lid (b) over rows 0-7, with a light fill and a green inner shape. Below it, rows 8-30 form a tall dark-green front face carrying the white text, which is 23 rows. This is not a flat slab. The top is only roughly 8 rows and is somewhat stylised, but it is a visible horizontal surface above a tall south face.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a vertical pharmacy sign: a pale green-white cabinet with a cap on top and a dark panel carrying the Korean text. Measured facts: 8 visible tones per tile, 0% near-flat coverage, 0% neutral dark edge pixels. That is above bus-shelter-a (6 tones, 9% flat) and below kiosk-a (12) and vending-a (20). The outline is tinted, a dark teal-green, not neutral black, so it counts as dark_material_tone. Shading is about 4 steps on the body (highlight, light, mid, dark) against 5-6 on kiosk-a and vending-a. The body is mostly smooth with little grain or speckle, and the sign panel is a simple dark field with glyphs, so texture is only some. Detail is clearly thinner than the kiosk and vending references, though the piece is a narrow single-purpose sign and comparable to the bus shelter. It is a slightly lower density, near the bottom of the accepted range, without being sticker-like. With little margin for error and the instruction to fail when in doubt, it falls just short of the standard.

answer.evidence: The width profile runs 8, 12, 16 (rows 2-6), 12, then 14 for the body. The top plate therefore widens and narrows again over rows 0-7, which reads as a lid-like ellipse that overhangs the 14px board by one pixel on each side. Row 7 is a darker line at the front rim, and rows 8-9 are dark navy that act as eave shadow. Below that, the green board with the white '약국' lettering is a vertical front face of 23 rows (rows 8-30). This call is uncertain: the plate carries a flat green emblem and could instead be a face-on sign header.

surfaces.part: top cap (white panel with green cross emblem, wider than the body)

answer.evidence: The width profile runs 8, 12, 16 (rows 2-6), 12, then 14 for the body. The cap is therefore a rounded plate that overhangs the 14px body. Row 7 is a darker front-edge line, followed by a dark outline row 8 and a navy shadow row 9, which reads as eave shadow under the overhang. Rows 1-6 are a light panel that reads as a top surface. Below it, rows 8-30 form a tall front face with the lettering, 23 rows. The cap could also be read as a front-facing sign head with a cross emblem. I counted it as a top because of the overhang, the edge line and the shadow beneath. The body itself is a flat vertical face with no top.
